set.body:
Close the measured 19-of-50 /v1 coverage gap and protect response shapes as future routes land.

Acceptance criteria

1. Account for every externally supported method/path on the reviewed dispatcher and future additions. Validate the separate supported authentication routes as a distinct surface.
2. Document and validate requests, success and error responses, scope-dependent nullable or omitted fields, expiry, idempotency, pagination and file-integrity headers for relevant operations.
3. The seeded packaged release response with provenance and a fixed-release response with restricted history both validate. Old compatible public payloads have explicit regression fixtures.
4. CI fails on a missing supported operation or an incompatible shape. Exercise an independent schema-driven client against the packaged service. Storage codecs stay private.

Verification

Retain route diff against the 50-operation baseline and schema-validation receipts from real response fixtures. Report the current denominator.

Source: docs/architecture-assessment-2026-11-18.md (b82cd14).
set.title: INT01: Make the public HTTP contract match the running service
